author: Zintenka
body:
Yeah, I know. Three consecutive maps... well that's cuz I'm bored and I feel like it :T 

So yeah... I used world painter for this one and I got to say... wow. Terrain looks dem fine. (Prolly cuz I'm experienced and downloaded custom mountain brushes) 

Anyway, here is the map...

[DTM] War Everlasting



Spawnkit:




Liberty Prime Armor (Fallout 3 reference)




Author:
Zintenka

Features:
  • TNT
  • Each kill gives you 16 xp bottles.
  • 5 monuments
  • 50vs50 (Huge map, would like to know max team size for the server. If it isn't 50, I'll use that instead.)
  • Night vision
  • Resistance X for 10 seconds after you spawn (Prevent spawn killing and the large scale of the map is appropriate for this.)

YML

Download 

Imgur

Bon Appetite! You sick fu-- I mean... very nice ppl :D

I hope the YML is good Para, I copied most of it from WarNeverChanges and from some of your maps. I fit in some stuff that I think will go greatly with the map. 

I also notice now that part of my errors were making spawn coords without the '.5's' at the end of the X and Z coords. Among other things...

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
I will keep the anvils. They add aesthetics. 

I did use it in it's appropriate way. If TNT is to be implemented the map must have a void gap. 

It makes no sense making a TNT cannon when ppl can just strafe around it and blow it up.

This wasn't a very constructive post... 

Tell me what i did wrong. Because to me, the aesthetics look plausible, the map seems like it will have cool and unique gameplay with enchanting, caverns and caves, and TNT. 

Large open space for enough PVPing and Cannoning. 

Caves that have a variety of resources.

Gravel paths that show you where to go. 

What's not to like? Seriously.

replies.author: LeCobalt
replies.body:
• In the times of Mc Zone Anvils were removed for a reason
  • Anvils can be used to spawn kill your own team by dropping them onto them.
  • Enemy team could trap their or the other team using anvils
  • About the WP thing is that on this map the contrast between void-terrain is high, which makes the map look a bit limited. For example on maps that don't have that high of a contrast like broken ages (name is something like that) the terrain actually looks like floating islands instead of it looking like a terrain was cut and pasted into the void.
  • I never said anything about the tnt
